ops-bot: Heads-up — on-floor mic rack swap scheduled at 15:00 PT. Expect a brief 5–10s noise/mute during the swap. Recording will continue but captions might flicker. I’ll post status updates here. :headphones:
eva: Noted. Is there a hot backup mic if the rack takes longer? @marta can you confirm?
marta: Yep, hot boundary mic staged and ready. If the rack is noisy I’ll hot-swap — should be <30s.
diane: Quick question — will the recording file be continuous or will we get a new file if OBS restarts? Need for the montage.
recording-bot: recording started at 2245001100, session id ah-2245-session (system)
raj: Also — leadership asked that if we’re running long we pull forward the roadmap Q&A and skip deep demos. Can we do that?
sam: Fine with me. Can we move the model-rollout section up (was slide 5)?
eva: Yes please — if we hit the 30-min mark, prioritize leadership Q&A over the walkthrough demo. @diane can you push an updated deck?
diane: Uploading updated deck now to Slides — changing order so rollout is earlier. Link once ready.
marta: FYI, if OBS needs a manual restart after the swap, run: ```bash
kubectl -n media rollout restart deploy/obs-encoder
```
ops-bot: If OBS restarts, stream may drop for ~12s. Fallback recording server will be enabled at ~15s. I’ll monitor and failover if needed.
sam: If stream drops I’ll post an ETA/notice in #all-hands and coordinate live updates.
eva: Leaders — quick roadmap clarifier: is Dedicated autoscale still aimed for Q3 or slipped?
kevin: We hit a couple infra dependency blockers; target moved to early Q4. I’ll confirm specifics during the Q&A and call out customer impact. :thinking_face:
eva: Thanks — if you confirm during the session we’ll update the public roadmap blurb after the meeting.
marta: Swap complete, no prolonged noise. Testing levels now (voice check ok).
recording-bot: recording is continuous — file id ah-2245-rc1.mp4 (system)
diane: Deck updated and shared — model rollout slide moved earlier. Link: https://slides.redwood/ah-2245 (internal)
sam: Will post a short interruption notice in ~2m if anything happens.
eva: Great — thanks everyone. Keep this thread for live Qs and any follow-ups post-handoff.
